module_summary: dash_store.c owns dashboard persistence: generic helpers (dashStrCopy, dashTrim, dashKvParse, dashLoadTextFile, dashWriteFile with read-back verify), the DASHBOARD.CNF/DASHAPPS.CNF parse and write path, and deferred worker-thread saves with per-file dirty/inflight flags, plus favorites/pins/recents/hidden lists. dash_themes.c is the theme engine: the DashTheme model, 18 built-in presets, validation, a table-driven key/value parser and serializer shared by DASHBOARD.CNF (Theme_ prefix) and THEMES/<name>/theme.cfg folders. dash_theme.c routes the classic uLE draw primitives (draw.c, draw_text.c, filer_browser.c) to gradient/panel/frame/glyph drawing using the active theme. dash_sound.c loads libsd+audsrv, uploads eight embedded ADPCM effects (or custom sidecars) and a looping BGM.ADP sidecar, tracking the IOP reset generation so stale RPC clients are never used. dash_smbd.c is the SMB server status screen.

reusable_helpers.name: dashStrCopy
reusable_helpers.what: bounded string copy that always NUL-terminates and accepts NULL src

reusable_helpers.name: dashTrim
reusable_helpers.what: in-place trim of spaces, tabs and CR/LF

reusable_helpers.name: dashKvParse
reusable_helpers.what: parses key = value text (BOM, comments, sections skipped) with a callback per pair

reusable_helpers.name: dashLoadTextFile
reusable_helpers.what: reads a whole file through genOpen into a NUL-terminated 64-byte aligned buffer with a size cap

reusable_helpers.name: dashWriteFile
reusable_helpers.what: creates SYS-CONF if needed, writes a whole file, then reads it back and compares

reusable_helpers.name: dashStoreBuildPath
reusable_helpers.what: joins the dashboard store directory with a file name

reusable_helpers.name: dashColorMix / dashColorLighten / dashColorScale
reusable_helpers.what: RGBA colour lerp keeping alpha, lighten towards white, clamped brightness scale

reusable_helpers.name: parseColor
reusable_helpers.what: parses #RRGGBB, RRGGBBAA or r,g,b[,a] into a colour

reusable_helpers.name: readAdpSidecar
reusable_helpers.what: reads and validates a mono APCM file beside the boot ELF into a DMA-padded buffer

findings.title: dashThemeFolderLoad and dashThemeFolderExport are dead copies of the worker-split FolderRead/FolderText/FolderWrite
findings.problem: dashThemeFolderLoad repeats dashThemeFolderRead line for line (plus apply), and dashThemeFolderExport repeats dashThemeFolderText + dashThemeFolderWrite. Neither has a caller: the only repo matches are their definitions, the prototypes at dash_internal.h:276-277 and old plan/spec docs. dash_settings.c uses only the split versions (2895, 2897, 2952).
findings.fix: Delete dashThemeFolderLoad, dashThemeFolderExport and their two prototypes. Optionally drop the stale names from docs/superpowers specs/plans.
findings.benefit: ~77 source lines removed. No ELF change: both are already discarded by --gc-sections (MEASURED: evidence/Launchstation/raw/link-raw/wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log:556-557; 956 + 384 bytes of .text never linked).
findings.evidence: Grep dashThemeFolderLoad|dashThemeFolderExport over all of src/Launchstation (src, include, tests, scripts, yaml, docs): dash_themes.c:1122/1161 definitions, dash_internal.h:276-277 prototypes, docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-26-osdsys-dash-design.md:163-164 and docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-26-osdsys-dash.md only. Callers of the split API: dash_settings.c:2895 (FolderRead), 2897 (FolderWrite), 2952 (FolderText). Compared bodies 1046-1079 vs 1122-1159 and 1082-1120 vs 1161-1195: same statements apart from the extra filerRootMcPollIdle calls and the final dashTheme = t; dashThemeCommit().

findings.title: Theme idle-save chain is dead: dashThemeMarkDirty has no caller, so dashThemeSavePending and dashStoreSaveTheme never act
findings.problem: theme_dirty is set to 1 only in dashThemeMarkDirty, which nothing calls, so dashThemeSavePending (called every UI frame at dash_main.c:1485 and before hand-off at :325) always returns at its first test, and its call to dashStoreSaveTheme (only caller) never runs. Theme edits are saved by settingsCommit via dashStoreSaveSettings (dash_settings.c:2421-2423, 2502-2504), so this path is a leftover.
findings.fix: Delete theme_dirty, dashThemeMarkDirty, dashThemeSavePending, dashStoreSaveTheme, their three prototypes and the two calls in dash_main.c (settleBackgroundWork keeps only the dashStoreFlushWait call).
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed; one call per UI frame removed. dashThemeMarkDirty is already gc-discarded (MEASURED: wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log:558); dashThemeSavePending and dashStoreSaveTheme stay linked today, a few dozen bytes (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep dashThemeMarkDirty|theme_dirty|dashThemeSavePending over src/Launchstation: theme_dirty only at dash_themes.c:1200,1283,1288,1290; dashThemeMarkDirty only dash_themes.c:1281 and dash_internal.h:298; dashThemeSavePending called at dash_main.c:325,1485. Grep dashStoreSaveTheme: dash_store.c:694 (def), dash_internal.h:641, dash_themes.c:1291 (only call). No test references any of these names. Read dash_settings.c:2416-2427 and 2496-2505: theme differences set dash_dirty, which triggers dashStoreSaveSettings.

findings.title: dashCfg.enabled and dashCfg.legacy_theme are always 1: unreachable settings cases, dead DashIsEnabled, redundant keep_enabled
findings.problem: Defaults set both fields to 1 and the parser forces 1 whatever the file says ('the dashboard is the only shell now', 'no unstyled classic look'). The only writes of other values are in the S_ENABLED / S_LEGACY_THEME switch cases, but neither id appears in any settings item table (grep: enum, two cases each), so they are unreachable. The only reader of enabled is DashIsEnabled, which has no caller; legacy_theme is read only in the unreachable case and written to DASHBOARD.CNF.
findings.fix: Delete both fields, the S_ENABLED/S_LEGACY_THEME enum values and their four switch cases, DashIsEnabled and its prototype, the keep_enabled save/restore, and the Dash_Enabled/Dash_LegacyTheme parse branches and output lines (dashKvParse already skips unknown keys in old files).
findings.benefit: ~28 source lines removed, two fewer keys written per DASHBOARD.CNF save. DashIsEnabled already gc-discarded (MEASURED: wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log:438); remaining code is a few hundred bytes of .text/.rodata at most (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Grep S_LEGACY_THEME|S_ENABLED in src: dash_settings.c:44,52 (enum), 1018,1021,1697,1701 (cases) only; compare S_ANIM which also appears in the item table at dash_settings.c:251. Grep DashIsEnabled over the whole repo: dash.h:18 and dash_main.c:200 only. Grep dashCfg.enabled|legacy_theme: dash_store.c 239,247,309,325,550; dash_settings.c 1019,1022,1698,1702,2753,2759; dash_main.c:203; dash_internal.h:572,580. dash_settings.c:2754-2758 already copies the old dashCfg back before 2759 reassigns enabled. No test mentions these keys or fields (tests grep: only an unrelated move_manifest.enabled).

findings.title: Small dead items in dash_themes.c: dashThemeBgId, dashThemePresetIndex, dashThemeMarkCustom, write-only store_seen and FolderCtx.folder_path
findings.problem: dashThemeBgId, dashThemePresetIndex and dashThemeMarkCustom have no caller (definition and prototype only). store_seen is assigned at 904/913 and never read. FolderCtx.folder_path is assigned but folderKv reads only ctx->t, so the struct is a needless wrapper around DashTheme*. P_CRT sets bold = 1, which base() already set (line 217).
findings.fix: Delete the three functions and prototypes, store_seen and its two assignments, the FolderCtx struct (pass the DashTheme pointer straight to dashKvParse as user data), and the redundant bold line in P_CRT.
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed. The three functions are already gc-discarded (MEASURED: wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log:553-555), so no ELF change from them.
findings.evidence: Grep over src/Launchstation (c, h, S, yaml, py, docs): dashThemeBgId only dash_themes.c:141 and dash_internal.h:284; dashThemePresetIndex only dash_themes.c:469 and dash_internal.h:257; dashThemeMarkCustom only dash_themes.c:631 and dash_internal.h:262; store_seen only dash_themes.c:44,904,913; folder_path member only 1020 (decl) and 1066/1144 (writes) - resolveInFolder uses its own parameter of that name. bg_ids stays used by the keys table at line 766.

findings.title: Dead accessors in dash_store.c: dashStorePersisted, dashStoreLoaded and the write-only store_loaded flag
findings.problem: dashStorePersisted and dashStoreLoaded have no caller in any source; store_loaded is read only by dashStoreLoaded, so its writes at 433 and 609-610 are dead too.
findings.fix: Delete both functions, their prototypes, store_loaded and its writes. tests/test_device_autostart_safe_mode.py:23 uses the text 'int dashStoreLoaded(void)' as the end marker of a slice; point it at the next function (dashStoreSettingsText or the Saving banner).
findings.benefit: ~14 source lines removed. Both functions already gc-discarded (MEASURED: wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log:504-505).
findings.evidence: Grep dashStorePersisted over the repo: dash_store.c:699, dash_internal.h:644 only. Grep dashStoreLoaded: dash_store.c:466, dash_internal.h:635, tests/test_device_autostart_safe_mode.py:23 (string marker only). store_loaded appears only at dash_store.c:21,433,468,610.

findings.title: Small redundancies in dash_store.c: twin toggle functions, zero stores after memset, one-line buildSettings wrapper, always-0 int returns
findings.problem: dashStoreToggleFavorite and dashStoreTogglePinned are the same 13 lines with fav/pin swapped. dashStoreDefaults memsets dashCfg and then stores 0 or '' into ten fields again (248, 251, 254, 255, 259, 261, 262, 264, 266, 267). buildSettings only forwards to dashStoreSettingsText(&persisted) for its one caller (640). dashStoreSaveSettings and dashStoreSaveLists always return 0 and no caller uses the value.
findings.fix: Make one static toggle(list, &n, path) used by both public toggles; drop the zero stores (keep the explanatory comments on the remaining lines if wanted); call dashStoreSettingsText(&persisted, ...) directly in submitSave; make the two save functions void.
findings.benefit: ~25 source lines removed; a few dozen bytes of .text (INFERRED: one function body instead of two).
findings.evidence: Read dash_store.c:807-833 side by side. Grep '[=(!&|]\s*dashStoreSave(Settings|Lists)|return dashStoreSave' over src: no use of the return value; all calls are statements (dash_apps.c:336,352,413,465; dash_files.c:694; dash_main.c:1534; dash_settings.c:2504; dash_tools.c:164,611,1066,1463). Test stubs in tests/test_cloud_menu.py:63 already declare it void; tests/test_settings_save_prompt.py:67 returns int and would need its stub signature changed. buildSettings referenced only at dash_store.c:640.

findings.title: isWritablePath in dash_themes.c duplicates isWritableDevice in dash_store.c
findings.problem: Both functions test the same eight device prefixes (mc, mass, usb, hdd, mmce, mx4sio, ilink, ata) with the same strncmp chain; they differ only in the NULL/empty guard of the dash_store.c copy.
findings.fix: Make isWritableDevice non-static (prototype in dash_internal.h), use it in themeRoots and delete isWritablePath.
findings.benefit: ~6 source lines removed net; one copy of the strncmp chain fewer in .text (INFERRED, under 100 bytes).
findings.evidence: Read both functions. Grep 'strncmp\([a-z_]+, "mx4sio", 6\)' over src: only these two functions contain the full writable-device list; other matches are single-device tests. isWritablePath used only at dash_themes.c:965; isWritableDevice at dash_store.c:208,210.

findings.title: dash_sound.c internal duplication: twin blob switches, repeated volume loop, BGM state reset and boot-dir expression
findings.problem: blob_data and blob_size are two 13-line switches over the same ids; the SFX volume loop in dashSoundInit equals dashSoundApplyVolume; the six-line BGM state reset (bgm_loaded, bgm_tried, bgm_channel, buffer, free) is copied in ReloadEffects and Shutdown; 'LaunchElfBootDir[0] ? LaunchElfBootDir : LaunchElfDir' is written four times; 'sound_ready && soundAlive()' repeats soundAlive's own test; iopcontrol.h is included but no SifIop* call is made.
findings.fix: Replace the two switches with one static table of {data, &size} indexed by id; set sound_ready/generation first and call dashSoundApplyVolume instead of the init loop; move the BGM reset into one static helper; add one static bootDir() helper; test only soundAlive() at 166; drop the iopcontrol.h include.
findings.benefit: ~30 source lines removed; small .text saving from one table instead of two switch functions (INFERRED, well under 1 KB).
findings.evidence: Read dash_sound.c 1-525 in full. blob_data/blob_size called only at line 154. dashSoundApplyVolume (320-328) loops the same SND_SFX_CH_MAX voices with dashCfg.sound ? sound_vol : 0; the init loop runs only when dashCfg.sound, so the result is the same once soundAlive() is true. Grep SifIop in dash_sound.c: no match. soundAlive() at 62-65 already starts with sound_ready.

findings.title: dash_smbd.c #else stub of DashSmbServer is never referenced, and its int return is ignored
findings.problem: The only caller of DashSmbServer is itself inside #ifdef ETH (dash_tools.c:1635-1637), so the non-ETH stub can never be called in any build (ETH is always set, ps2.yaml:624, and configure_ds34.py does not remove it). The caller also discards the 0/1 return value.
findings.fix: Delete the #else stub (and its #else), and make DashSmbServer return void (definition and the dash.h:25 prototype).
findings.benefit: ~3 source lines removed; no ELF change (INFERRED: the stub is not compiled with ETH set).
findings.evidence: Grep DashSmbServer over src: dash_tools.c:1637 (inside #ifdef ETH at 1635), dash_smbd.c:38 and :82. Grep \bETH\b in yaml/py: ps2.yaml:624 defines it; scripts/configure_ds34.py has no ETH match.
